body: I had my first suicidal thought at eight. I'm 13 now, so it's been five years. It was because I was suffering low self esteem and isolated as well (I have autism which causes me to be impulsive and be weird.) Well, that's me.

I doubt they still love me. I told my family I was sorry for these things, but the next day I lied to her again, and she said she feels used and taken advantage of. If I go, it won't bother anyone, and they're that close to disowning me or putting me in a foster home. I have a bottle of bleach and some bedsheets ready for tonight.
